supporting_news.title: RBI may opt for 25 bps rate hike as oil eases, inflation risks persist: Baroda BNP Paribas MF CIO
supporting_news.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is projected to implement a 0.25 percent interest rate hike in December. While decreasing crude oil prices could alleviate some inflation worries, many senior executives advocate for a measured strategy due to the prevailing economic climate. Nevertheless, concerns regarding food inflation and supply chain issues persist, adversely influencing overall forecasts.

supporting_news.title: RBI net buyer of dollars for fourth straight month in September, data shows
supporting_news.summary: The Reserve Bank of India recorded net purchases of $6.94 billion in the foreign exchange market during September. It bought a total of $82.18 billion while selling $75.25 billion in currency transactions. Despite a decline in the rupee, capital inflows reached about $143 billion due to various measures. Indian equities have recently attracted investors, leading to a rise in the rupee's value.

supporting_news.title: US Treasury gains lift India bonds ahead of RBI meet
supporting_news.summary: On Wednesday, Indian government bonds rallied, influenced by a decrease in US Treasury yields. The benchmark 10-year bond yield fell to 7.1641%, marking a two-week low. The Indian rupee strengthened to its highest level for the fiscal year against the dollar. Overseas investors returned as net buyers of Indian debt, purchasing over 93 billion rupees. The Reserve Bank of India's upcoming decision will significantly affect market movements and trends.

supporting_news.title: India bonds inch higher as oil steadies ahead of RBI verdict
supporting_news.summary: Indian government bonds have experienced a modest rise, driven by declining oil prices and consistent US Treasury yields. With the Reserve Bank of India's policy decision approaching, traders are treading carefully and shying away from large investments. The yield for the benchmark 2036 bond has dropped, suggesting a cautious market outlook.
